title: My hero
text: Hi, Bobby. I want to do the shopping for Mrs Pig.
Great! Mrs Fox asked us to write about our heroes.
Who do you want to write about?
A famous scientist or inventor. They work hard and do great things.
Hi, Mrs Mouse! Thanks for taking my baby to the park yesterday.
sentences: Mrs Fox asked us to write about our heroes.
They work hard and do great things.
